data.heading: 1. Kharif Season Sowing Status:
data.text: -  Kharif  sowing  data  collection  has  started  from  05 th June,  2026  and  the  sowing  is  in  preliminary stage. As on 05 July 2026, the area sown under Kharif crops is 350.85 lakh ha (including 57.58 lakh ha in Sugarcane) as compared to 442.80 lakh ha during the corresponding period of last year.

data.heading: Week 1 (02 July - 08 July 2026):
data.text:
-  No significant changes in Maximum temperature over the country till 08 July 2026.
-  Maximum temperatures  likely  to  rise  by  1.6-3°C  over  some  parts  of  northeast  India  and  isolated pockets of Northwest India

data.heading: Details of each Segment
data.text:
-  No significant Heatwave conditions are likely over any part of the country during the week.
-  Above normal (+1.6 to +3.0°C) maximum temperatures are likely over some parts of the plains of northeast  India.  Near-normal  weekly maximum temperatures (-1.5 to +1.5°C) are likely across the rest of the country during week 2.
-  No  Warm  Night  conditions  are  likely  over  any  part  of  the  country  during  the  week.  However, minimum temperatures are likely to be near normal (+1.6 to +3.0°C) over parts of northwest India (Punjab, Haryana, Rajasthan, & Uttar Pradesh), and near Normal (-1.5 to +1.5°C) for the country.

data.heading: Kharif Crops - Area coverage
data.text:
-  Sugarcane : About 57.58 lakh ha area coverage (106% of Normal area) has been reported compared to 56.72 lakh ha during the corresponding period of last year.
-  Cotton : About 63.18 lakh ha area coverage has been reported compared to 82.00 lakh ha during the corresponding period of last year.
-  Jute :  About  6.28  lakh  ha  area  coverage  has  been  reported  compared  to  6.16  lakh  ha  during  the corresponding period of last year.
